>>C<< ROCKER ARM, ROCKER ARM SHAFT AND 
ROCKER SHAFT SPRING INSTALLATION
1. Rotate the camshaft until the dowel pin on its front end is 
located as shown in the illustration.
NOTE: Placing the camshaft in the illustrated position 
minimizes the amount of cam lift, making it easier to install 
the rocker arm and shaft assemblies.
2. Install the exhaust side rocker arm "C" and shaft assembly 
to the cylinder head.
3. Install the inlet side rocker arms "A" and "B" and shaft 
assembly to the cylinder head.
4. Insert the rocker shaft spring to the intake side rocker arm 
shaft as illustrated.
5. Make sure that the notch in the end of the rocker arm shaft 
is facing the direction as shown.
